title: Hydra review verdict: strict target for the helper reviewer
description: The object hydraReviewPrompt asks for (app/prompts.go) and review() decodes into reviewVerdict (app/hydra.go, Chimera 0.6.1). score must be a JSON integer literal: Go rejects 85.0 and 85.5, and a reply that fails to decode ends the loop as if done. Chimera never reads score today. The helper may also write "check" (its requirement-by-requirement check, before the verdict): reviewVerdict has no such field and json.Unmarshal ignores unknown fields, so Chimera reads the same verdict.

check.description: optional, the helper's own: each requirement of the task and whether the result meets it, written before the verdict; Chimera ignores it

critique.description: if not done: the specific things still missing or wrong and what the next round should fix; if done: empty
